sourceNote: The Tripo P2 deer mesh with its quads (assets/models/deer/README.md). The hand rig assets/models/deer/tripo-hand/deer.blend starts from it in headless Blender with the calls of tools/blender/body_armature.py (design 4.4, "Hand rig").
name: Deer

bind.trunkNote: The trunk of the seated bind sits upright (trunk_turn() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The pelvis turns back until the hip angle opens by open degrees, and each trunk bone takes its share. The values are those of the deer of main (tools/mesh-rigs/deer.json at cbc8db5e4).
bind.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (Body.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are those of the deer of main (tools/mesh-rigs/deer.json at cbc8db5e4), so that the elbow axes of the harp hold stay.
bind.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
bind.bindSupinationNote: The bind hooves take no supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so the bind forearms have no twist.
bind.tailBindNote: The tail bones keep the directions of the source in the bind, so that the short tail stays behind the haunch.
bind.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 15 degrees out, and the shin leans 35 degrees forward of vertical, and the foot turns 0 degrees with the heel up (with 0, the hooves stay flat on the floor) (uv run --no-project --with numpy python -I tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 35 0).

tone.note: No move. The hand route does not read the tone. The color map of the source replaces the face colors in the app.

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the texture at a grid of samples. A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples are below dark. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a face in the nose box near the nose color is the nose. A palette of palette colors (k-means in Oklab) keeps the colors few.
colors.eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (|x| 0.016 to 0.059, y 0.844 to 0.887, z 0.041 to 0.084; spheres of radius 0.0217 about (0.0376, 0.8657, 0.0628)). The nose box holds the dark nose at the tip of the muzzle.

eyeShell.note: Each eye shell is a fan from the middle of the dark faces of the eye to at most points points of their edge, lifted along the normal of the eye. pnpm body-module drops the fan, and the app puts its pea eye there (design 4.5). The faces of the old eye take the main color of the ring around it.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature). The half width holds the haunch (x -0.119 to 0.119).

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units, as on the other bodies.

jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, in the body units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (closed rings of 11 vertices from x 0.113 to x 0.236, axis y 0.647 to 0.650, radius 0.037 to 0.020): the shoulder joint at x 0.095, at the trunk side, the elbow at x 0.175, in the middle from the shoulder to the wrist, the wrist at x 0.25, where the pastern widens, the knuckles at x 0.315, where the two toes of the hoof part, the tip at x 0.353. Leg (closed rings of 11 vertices from y 0.088 to y 0.281): the hip joint at (0.055, 0.33, -0.03) in the haunch, the knee at y 0.245, at the narrow ring between the thigh and the calf, the ankle at y 0.055, where the hoof starts, and the hoof tips at z 0.025. Trunk: the spine bones lie near the middle of the depth. The long neck is narrowest at y 0.72 to 0.76, and the chin is at y 0.775. Ears: the root at (0.06, 0.905, -0.02), the tips at (0.14, 0.995, -0.09). Tail: the short tail behind the rump, from its root at (0, 0.45, -0.10) back and down to (0, 0.36, -0.19). The palm is the true palm of the source: the mean normal of the hoof faces that face down (x from 0.30) is (0.159, -0.987, -0.034). The hoof turn of the build turns it with the hoof. The joints of the config are these places mapped by the point edits of the build: the arm stretch (armStretch, 1.5) moves the elbow to x 0.214, the wrist to x 0.3256, and the knuckles to x 0.3924.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/body-module.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source, and the seat width 0.57 m of the stool, 1.3 times the stool of the old deer, which holds the haunch (0.43 m wide at this scale).
eyeSizeNote: The head height H of the body in units, as body-module measures it on the export, before the head size. The hand rig keeps the eyes of the mesh, so it places no pea eye.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: 1.3 times the scale at which the standing shoulder joints (0.647 units) are 0.897127 m high, as on the deer of main (assets/models/deer/deer.rig.glb at cbc8db5e4). At 1.3, the seated crown with no ears is at the height of the seated crown of the Tripo wolf, and the shoulder joints are 1.166265 m high. The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale. The head, the trunk, the hooves, and the legs keep the form of the source.
chairNote: The seat of the rig in units of this body, as the property seat of the armature of tripo-hand/deer.blend holds it.
rollSplitNote: The simple route splits the roll segments by place (roll_split() of tools/blender/simple_rig.py). The hand rig sets the same split in the exact rows of each arm ring (assets/models/wolf/README.md, "tripo-hand/wolf.blend").
